label: SYNTHETIC (generator panel) + OBSERVED (PHL UIS completion series)
brief: Council brief 022 (D122 #2); SYNTHESIS_022.md section 6, EXP-7 REPRO-PATH, rank #2
dependency_role: precondition for the v1.5 BIMODAL-GATE predeclaration (brief 022 section 4.4)
statement: Descriptive/diagnostic audit of a declared-assumption simulator. No causal and no direction claim; D63 remains UNABLE as to cause. The kappa link is a declared accounting constraint taken from an observed median (never fitted), not an estimated relationship. m = 1.10 and v1.2's scope (crossing/endpoint placement) are unchanged. No threshold was changed after results.

copies_inside_experiment_dir.note: No generator code was copied or edited: leg (b) is an in-memory projection on a byte copy of the frozen panel. No file under generator_v1_2/ was written or modified.

declared_parameters.kappa_provenance: median of the 8 observed PHL upper_t/lower_{t-3} pairs; re-derived 0.94914 -> 0.949
declared_parameters.lag_rule: exact t-3; no nearest-year matching in leg (b)

construction.leg_a_missing_rule: MISSING retained in denominator; never imputed, dropped or nearest-year substituted
construction.leg_b_not_scorable_rule: no lower_{t-3} in panel; excluded from denominator; never imputed

results_files.results/PATH_COMPARISONS.csv: 33 rows; every comparison with year, level, synthetic, observed, deviation pp, within flags
results_files.results/KAPPA_LINK.csv: 56 rows (53 SCORED + 3 NOT-SCORABLE); upper_t, lower_{t-3}, ratio, bound, violation, linked value, delta, class
results_files.results/REPRO_PATH_RESULTS.csv: long-format (test, statistic, value, threshold, verdict, components)
results_files.results/BASELINE_GUARD.json: G1-G4 with hashes and pre/post comparison
results_files.results/console.txt: captured console of run 1 (byte-identical to run 2)
results_files.results/BASELINE_UNLINKED_PANEL.csv: byte copy of the frozen panel (5 086 014 bytes)

determinism.method: two clean runs of the same RNG-free, timestamp-free script into results/ and results/determinism_run2/, then sha256 and byte comparison of all six artifacts

discipline.labels: SYNTHETIC on generator numbers; OBSERVED on PHL completion numbers

implication_for_v1_5_bimodal_gate: The pipeline link must be built into v1.5 as a structural accounting constraint evaluated inside the model each year, with kappa a declared system input, not applied as post-processing. v1.2's 2024 upper endpoint (76.64) may not be carried into v1.5 as a ceiling target or as evidence of inheritance: under the declared link it falls to 63.97 (delta -12.67 pp). v1.5 level claims must be scored on the path (a count over observed year-level cells), not on a single endpoint.
